meta.title: Stackrift — the falling-blocks game, reinvented
meta.description: The falling-blocks game reinvented: brand-new modes, a daily challenge, shattering crystal. Free, no sign-up, on mobile and desktop.

app.name: Stackrift
app.tagline: The rules you know. Games you have never played.
app.privacy: No account, no tracking: your records stay on your device.
app.privacyPortal: No account, no tracking: the platform you play on keeps your progress.

home.quick: A game of Classic, right now

daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.rules: Two minutes, the same pieces for everyone.

classic.name: Classic
classic.pitch: The reference: a little faster every 10 lines.

tide.name: Tide
tide.pitch: Rows rise from the bottom, faster and faster. Hold on.

flip.name: Flip
flip.pitch: Turn the well upside down: the stack falls back and holes vanish.

chroma.name: Chroma
chroma.pitch: A line of a single colour is worth four times as much.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.pitch: Every 10 lines, the well is mirrored. Adapt.

fusion.name: Fusion
fusion.pitch: Six blocks of one colour fuse: set off chain reactions.

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.pitch: Every 10 lines the well turns: the left wall becomes the floor.

silhouette.name: Silhouette
silhouette.pitch: A puzzle a day: fill the shape with a limited number of pieces.

rhythm.name: Rhythm
rhythm.pitch: Land your pieces on the beat to multiply your points.

duel.name: Duel
duel.pitch: Face an AI: every line you clear sends rows to your opponent.

mosaic.name: Mosaic
mosaic.pitch: Place ceramic pieces, complete rows and columns, earn jokers.

sand.name: Sand
sand.pitch: Pieces crumble into grains: link both walls with a single colour.

tower.name: Tower
tower.pitch: The well rolls into a glass cylinder: a line goes all the way round.

notice.mirrorSoon: The well is about to be mirrored
notice.tiltSoon: The well is about to tilt

controls.label: Touch controls
controls.keyboard: Keyboard: arrows to move and drop, Space for a hard drop, ↑ or X to rotate, Ctrl to rotate the other way, C to hold, F for the ability, Esc to pause.
controls.touch: Touch: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down fast for a hard drop.

duelHint.rookie: Slow, still learning the game, often wrong.
duelHint.normal: Solid: it holds pieces and builds up its attacks.
duelHint.hard: Fast, it plans for the next piece and rarely errs.
duelHint.expert: As good as the best players: it never errs.

mosaic.noJoker: Clear several lines at once to earn jokers.
mosaic.helpKeyboard: Keyboard: 1, 2, 3 to pick a piece (4 for the cube), arrows to move it, Enter to place it, J for the jokers, Esc to cancel or pause.
mosaic.helpTouch: Touch: drag a piece onto the board, or tap it then tap a cell.

sand.helpKeyboard: Keyboard: arrows to move and drop, Space for a hard drop, ↑ or X to rotate, Ctrl to rotate the other way, Esc to pause. A single-colour region linking both walls is cleared.
sand.helpTouch: Touch: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down fast for a hard drop. Water takes the colour around it, fire burns the colour it touches.

tower.helpKeyboard: Keyboard: arrows to move and drop, Space for a hard drop, ↑ or X to rotate, Ctrl to rotate the other way, C to hold, Q and E (A and E on AZERTY) to turn the tower, Esc to pause. A line is a full ring of 20 cells.
tower.helpTouch: Touch: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down fast for a hard drop, drag with two fingers to turn the tower. The camera follows the piece.

objectives.duel: Beat the normal AI or a stronger one

progress.title: Progress
progress.tooShort: Play for at least 20 seconds to earn experience.

cosmetics.title: Atelier
cosmetics.intro: Everything here is cosmetic: none of it changes the game. Play to unlock more.

scope.material: For the falling modes (the Tower keeps its glass).
scope.shatter: For the falling modes and the Tower.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.spare: {n} star to spend | {n} stars to spend

starRule.timeLeft: 1 star for winning, 2 with 15 % of the time left, 3 with 40 %.
starRule.lines: 1 star for lasting, 2 from {two} lines cleared, 3 from {three}.
starRule.fast: 1 star for winning, 2 in under {two}, 3 in under {three}.

campaign.noBetter: No better than your best result.

upgrades.title: Upgrades
upgrades.intro: Spend your campaign stars: each upgrade has three ranks. They only work in the campaign; you can take every star back to try something else.

hourglass.name: Hourglass
hourglass.effect: +{value} s on the clock of timed levels

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.effect: Second chance: {value} bottom rows cleared, once per level

satchel.name: Satchel
satchel.effect: +{value} jokers at the start of the Mosaic

demo.title: Demo.
demo.banner: Five modes in free play (Classic, Sand, Mosaic, Tower, Duel) and the first chapter of the campaign. The full game has thirteen modes and thirty levels.
demo.campaignDone: Demo complete: the rest is in the full game.
